items.title: Mastercard (MA) Starts A Cross Border Stablecoin Payments Pilot
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE: MA) and Borderless.xyz announced a pilot collaboration to advance trusted cross-border stablecoin payments using Mastercard Crypto Credential standards. The initiative applies Mastercard Crypto Credential compliance and verification frameworks to blockchain based transactions for international value transfer.
